subject: chemistry

items.q: What is the main gas in the air?
items.why: Air is roughly 78% nitrogen and 21% oxygen, with small amounts of other gases.

items.q: Are global warming and the ozone hole the same problem?
items.correct: No — they are separate issues that are often confused.
items.misconception: Yes, the ozone hole causes global warming.
items.random_wrong: Carbon dioxide destroys the ozone layer.
items.why: The greenhouse effect (CO₂/methane trapping heat) is distinct from ozone depletion (caused by CFCs).

items.q: Does burning fossil fuels only produce carbon dioxide?
items.correct: No — incomplete combustion also gives carbon monoxide and soot.
items.misconception: Yes, combustion gives off carbon dioxide and nothing else.
items.why: Sulfur impurities also give sulfur dioxide (acid rain); incomplete burning gives toxic CO.
